kids-money-shop: Money Shop for Kids: Learn Rupees, Paying and Change
A play shop with rupee notes and coins. Children pay exact prices, give change as the shopkeeper, and fill a basket in their own shop. Free, private, works on phones.
tambola-ticket-generator: Tambola Ticket Generator and Number Caller (Housie)
Make printable tambola tickets, 6 per sheet using every number 1 to 90, and call numbers on screen with a board and optional voice. Free, no sign-up, private.
